sourceAuthoredSummary:
1.	Adding new IEs “F1-U TNL Info to Add or Modify List” and “F1-U TNL Info to Remove List” into the “BC MRB To Modify Item” structure for managing multiple F1-U TNL contexts, as well as adding a new IE “F1-U TNL Info Added or Modified List” into the response structure.
2.	Adding new IEs “F1-U TNL Info to Add List” into the “BC MRB To Add Item” structure for managing multiple F1-U TNL contexts, as well as adding a new IE “F1-U TNL Info Added List” into the response structure.
3. 	Introducing a “Broadcast F1-U Context Reference” IE type in order to enable correlating F1-U resources to the respective resources at the gNB-CU-UP.
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the broadcast MBS session management function.
This CR is backward compatible from a protocol and functional point of view.

2.	Adding new IEs “F1-U TNL Info to Add List” into the “BC MRB To Add Item” structure for managing multiple F1-U TNL contexts, as well as adding a new IE “F1-U TNL Info Added List” into the response structure.
3. 	Introducing a “Broadcast F1-U Context Reference” IE type in order to enable correlating F1-U resources to the respective resources at the gNB-CU-UP.

This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the broadcast MBS session management function.
This CR is backward compatible from a protocol and functional point of view.

9.1.1.8: removing the spaces within the references to RRCResumeRequest, RRCConnectionResumeRequest and RRCConnectionResumeRequestNB.
9.1.2.20: references to QoE related RRC names changed to italics font
9.1.2.29: including the verb “contains” to specify the RRC references for the content of the SCG Failure Report Container IE.
9.1.3.16: removing the space in the reference to the RRCReestablishmentRequest message; including the noun “message” to one of the references.
9.1.3.25: correcting the name of the reference to the PSCell List Container IE to CellIDListNR as of TS 36.331.
9.2.2.12: The FreqBandIndicatorPriority IE indicates the ng-eNB’s support of the freqBandIndicatorPiority, not the freqBandIndicationPriority, as of TS 36.331.
9.2.2.59: the LTE UE RLF Report Container IE contains the rlf-Report-r9, not the RLF-Report-r9, which in TS 36.331 is defined as fieldname, not as an IE.
9.2.2.59: the LTE UE RLF Report Container Extend Band IE contains the rlf-Report-v9e0, not the rLF-Report-v9e0, as of TS 36.331
9.2.2.76: the MeasObject Container IE includes the MeasObjectToAddModList IE, a fieldname measObjectToAddMod is not defined in TS 38.331.
9.2.2.76: the ReportConfiguration Container IE includes the ReportConfigToAddMod IE, a fieldname reportConfigToAddMod- is not defined in TS 38.331.
9.2.2.89: the BAP Address IE correspons to the iab-donor-DU-BAP-Address, not the iab-donor-DU-BAP-address, as of TS 38.331.
9.2.2.90: the BAP Path ID IE corresponds to the bap-PathId, not the bap-Pathid, as of TS 38.331
9.3.5: UERLFReportContainerLTE contains the rlf-Report-r9, not the RLF-Report-r9 IE, which in TS 36.331 is defined as fieldname, not as an IE.
9.3.5: UERLFReportContainerLTEExtendBand contains the rlf-Report-v9e0, not the rLF-Report-v9e0, as of TS 36.331

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Add support for NR UE Rx-Tx time difference for NR UL E-CID measurement reporting.

Note:
LMF is expected to request also request gNB Rx-Tx TD (i.e. NR Timing Advance) if it requests UE Rx-Tx TD.
If gNB provides UE Rx-TX TD measurement result, it should ensure (via implementation) time alignment with the gNB Rx-Tx TD measurement (i.e. NR Timing Advance) result.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
The issue is addressed correctly in the Error Indication message, which can also be used in both, single- and dual-connectivity: in case of DC, the “new” node is the M-NG-RAN node and the “old” node is the S-NG-RAN node. The same semantic descritpion is proposed to be used in case of the Xn-U Address Indication and in the RRC Transfer procedures.
For the Activity Notification procedure, it is proposed to add missing numbers at the “direction” definition and to add the link between the M/S-NG-RAN nodes and the nodes ‘1’ and ‘2’ in the semantics.

2, In the reference “36:214”, point should replace the column.
8.1, there is an extra blank after the ACTIVATION in "POSITIONING ACTIVATION “ then back to line and “FAILURE".
8.2.8. reference of TS 23.273 should be [20] and not [Xx].
9.1.1.1 presence of some IEs should be 0..1 instead of 0.
9.1.1.1 the criticality of the Other-RAT Measurement Quantities Item IE is not aligned on ASN.1, should be reject.
Further, the Other-RAT Measurement Quantities IE should have a YES/ignore and the Other-RAT Measurement Quantities Item IE should have a EACH/reject included in the respective columns. This is applicable to other “List” and “Item” IEs.
9.1.1.6,  The Message Type IE criticality of E-CID MEASUREMENT TERMINATION COMMAND should be aligned on ASN.1 i.e. reject.
9.1.4.2: The MEASUREMENT RESPONSE message is non UE associated, remove mention of message being associated to a target UE.
9.1.4.4, the Message Type IE criticality of MEASUREMENT REPORT should be aligned on ASN.1 i.e. ignore.
9.1.4.6, the Message Type IE criticality of MEASUREMENT ABORT should be aligned on ASN.1 i.e. ignore.
9.1.4.7, The Message Type IE criticality of MEASUREMENT FAILURE INDICATION should be aligned on ASN.1 i.e. ignore.
9.2.5: Report mapping of NR TA is defined in TS 38.133, not in TS 38.315.
9.2.5, 9.2.13, PCI EUTRA IE missing the ellipsis in many place in tabular.
9.2.6, NR Cell Identifier IE & E-UTRAN Cell Identifier IE, could be put in same order as ASN.1.
9.2.13, EARFCN IE, missing the ellipsis in tabular (may not only that place).
9.2.13,   RSRP EUTRA IE, missing the ellipsis in tabular (may not only that place).
9.2.13, RSRQ EUTRA IE, missing the ellipsis in tabular (may not only that place).
9.2.14, in the WLAN Measurement Result Item IE the presence of the BSSID IE is not aligned on ASN.1 should be O.
9.2.37, add the "UL RTOA Measurement" in the reference of the UL RTOA IE.
9.2.51, in the Coordinate ID IE, it is missing a point in the ellipsis
9.2.60, the choice indentation is not correct.
9.2.70 Merge with the correction proposed in R3-234463.

ASN.1: assigning “level 4” in the ASN.1 PDU and IE module for better navigation.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
7, 8.7.15, 9.1.4.24: unifying the name of the messages of the E-UTRA - NR Cell Resource Coordination procedures.
8.2.1.2: applicable code point of the IEs of ENUMERATED type explicated: Deactivation Indication IE.
8.2.1.2: removal the duplicated “the” in the Handover Request procedure.
8.2.2.2: aligning the name of the DRBs Subject To Status Transfer List IE and the DRBs Subject To Status Transfer List IE with their name used in tabular message representation.
8.2.6.2: aligning the name of the CPC Data Forwarding indicator IE with the name used in the tabular representation.
8.7.20: correction of misspelled “operation” in the Figure title for Deactivate Trace procedure.
9.1.1.8: change font type of range indication for the Candidate Cells To Be Cancelled List IE to italic.
9.1.2.19: removal of duplication of “in”.
9.1.2.45-50, 9.1.4.28/29: correcting the reference to the Message Type IE.
9.1.2.50: Correct criticality assignment from “EACH” to “-“ for the RA Report IE to align with ASN.1.
9.1.4.6: introducing a missign space in the Semantics description of the Available fast MCG recovery via SRB3 IE;
9.1.4.21: introducing a missing space in the Sematics description of the RRC Container included in the Fast MCG Recovery via SRB3 from MeNB to SgNB IE;
Global: replacing “Ies” by “IEs” where appropriate.
9.3.5: UE-RLF-Report-Container contains the rlf-Report-r9, not the RLF-Report-r9 IE, which in TS 36.331 is defined as fieldname, not as an IE. Same applies to the UE-RLF-Report-Container-for-extended-bands.

The CR is backwards compatible from a protocol point of view.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
To be backwards compatible, update the Tabular to add Receive Status Of PDCP SDU for the PDCP Status Transfer DL, and specify that this new IE is not used in this version of the specification.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because we clarify that one IE is not used in the PDCP Status Transfer DL IE in the SN STATUS TRANSFER message
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. The correction clarifies that one IE is not used in the SN STATUS TRANSFER even if ASN.1 enables this. The impact only affects nodes using the IE in a way not intended.
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects SN STATUS TRANSFER message.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
The NR-U Channel Bandwidth IE is updated to include a codepoint for 100 MHz. 

Impact analysis:
this CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release), from a functional and protocol point of view.
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the support of Bandwidth=100 MHz for NR-U Channel. From a protocol point of view, the CR adds a backwards compatible change.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Review of consistent usage of message names and IE names in procedural text and tabular, arbitrating sometimes with naming in ASN.1
8.1: the message names of the Xn Removal elementary procedure were changed to use capital letters throughout (XN REMOVAL REQUEST etc).
8.2.1.2: correction spelling inaccuracies of the following IE names used in procedure text to align with IE names used in tabular:
QoS Flows To Be Setup List IE IE
PDU Session Resources To Be Setup List IE / PDU Session Resources To Be Setup List IE
PDU Session Resources To Be Setup Item IE
PDU Session level UL data Forwarding UP TNL Information IE
Additional UL NG-U UP TNL Information at UPF List IE
QoS Flows To Be Setup List IE
MBS Data Forwarding Response Info from target NG-RAN node IE
Associated QoS Flow Information List IE
8.2.2.2: aligning the name of the DRBs Subject To Status Transfer List IE and the Receive Status Of UL PDCP SDUs IE with their name used in tabular message representation.
8.2.1.2, 8.2.4.2: aligning the name of the UE Context Reference at the S-NG-RAN node IE and the UE Slice Maximum Bit Rate List IE with its name used in tabular message representation.
8.2.4.2: aligning the name of the UE Context Information – Retrieve UE Context Response IE with the name used in the tabular representation.
8.2.5.2, 9.1.1.7: correcting misspelling of the UE Specific DRX IE to align with spelling used in the majority of cases.
8.2.6.2: alinging the name of the CPC Data Forwarding indicator IE with the name used in the tabular representation.
8.2.1.2, 8.3.1.2, 8.3.3.2, 8.3.3.4: aligning the name of the PDU Session level UL data Forwarding UP TNL Information IE with the one used in the tabular representation.
8.3.1.2, 8.3.3.2: aligning the name of the Alternative QoS Parameters Set List IE and the Location Information at S-NODE reporting IE with the ones used in the tabular representation.
8.3.1.2: aligning the name of the Conditional PSCell Addition Information Acknowledge IE and the PDU Session Resources Admitted To Be Added List IE with the ones used in the tabular representation.
8.3.1.4: aligning the name of the PDU Session Resources To Be Added Item IE and the PDU Session Resources Admitted To Be Added List IE with the ones used in the tabular representation.
8.3.3.2: removal of duplication of “the”, correcting a grammatical error in the paragraphs specifying the Interaction with the Xn-U Address Indication procedure.
8.3.5.2: correcting the name of the S-NG-RAN node to M-NG-RAN node Container IE description in the S_NODE CHANGE REQUIRED message.
8.3.9.2: removal duplications of “the”, correcting the name of the UE Report IE to align with tabular representation.
8.4.9.2: aligning the name of the NG-RAN node1 SSB Offset Information IE and the NG-RAN node2 Proposed SSB Offset Information IE with the ones used in the tabular representation;
rewording the sentence to cope with the fact that an SSB Index IE doesn’t exist (⇒“... should take into account the included value of the SSB Offset for ....”)
8.4.14.1: correcting the Access And Mobility Indication procedure name
8.4.12.1, 9.1.3.25: aligning the IE names between procedural text, tabular represenation and ASN.1 names for the RA Report, the Successful HO Report Information IE and the Successful PSCell Change Report Information IE.
8.5.2.2, 8.5.2.3: aligning the IAB QoS Mapping information IE name of the with the one used in tabular representation.
8.5.3.2: aligning the IE name of the IAB TNL Address To Be Released List IE with the name used in tabular and ASN.1.
9.1.2.5: correction of the reference to “PDU Session List with Cause 9.2.1.26”, inserting a comma in the type definition of the SN triggered IE.
9.1.2.6: introducing a missing space in the Semantics description of the Available fast MCG recovery via SRB3 IE;
9.1.2.9: correcting references to IE names to align with IE names used in that references. (PDU Session List 9.2.1.27)
9.1.2.11: correcting references to IE names to align with IE names used in that references. (PDU Session List with Cause 9.2.1.26)
9.1.2.17: correcting references to IE names to align with IE names used in that references. (PDU Session List with data forwarding request info 9.2.1.24)
9.1.4.2: aligning the name of the F1-Terminating Topology BH Information IE as of the IE name reference.
9.2.2.83: correcting the name of the IAB QoS mapping information IE to aling with the IE name in the reference ().
9.2.3.97: changing the IE name of the QoS Flow Identifier IE to align with name of the reference.
9.2.3.169: correcting the IE name: MDT PLMN Modification List IE
Further editorials:
3.1: adding in definitions a reference to 38.401 for “Boundary IAB-node”.
3.2: correcting the spelling of the name of the A2X abbreviation (Aircraft-to-Everything) and adding an abbreviation for “LBT” (Listen-Before-Talk”).
8.x: font type of IE names changed to italics, “IE” added to IE names where missing, adding missing article “the” where applicable, 
8.1, 9.1.2.23, 9.1.2.24, 9.3.4: unifying the name of the messages of the E-UTRA -NR Cell Resource Coordination elementary procedure.
8.2.1.2, 8.2.4.2, 8.3.1.2, 8.3.3.2, 8.3.4.2, 8.3.12.2, 8.3.16.2: applicable code point of the IEs of ENUMERATED type explicated: RAN Paging Failure IE, IAB Node Indication IE, No PDU Session Indication IE, F1-terminating IAB donor Indication IE, Direct Forwarding Path Availability IE, Privacy Indicator IE, Deactivation Indication IE.
8.2.4.2: a space between “TS 23.287” and “[38]” was missing.
8.3.14.2: inserting a missing space (“... "Immediate MDT Only" or ...”)

sourceAuthoredSummary:
§3.1: Reordered to be alphabetized.
§3.2: Reordered to be alphabetized, and missing acronyms added.
§8.2.1.4: “REQUEST” changed to “RESPONSE” since failure is reported by NG-RAN node.
§8.2.3.2: Three occurrences of “Setup” changed to “Modify” since this is the PDU Session Resource Modify procedure (copy/paste error?)
§8.3.1.2: The word “received” was added in 3 places for consistency with all other bullets in the list
§8.3.1.2, 8.3.4.2, 8.4.2.2, 8.4.4.2: “mobile terminated communication handling” changed to “MT communication handling” for consistency with section 8.3.13.
§8.3.1.4, 8.4.2.4, 8.11.1.3: Abnormal condition was reworded since the Area Scope of MDT IE is mandatory (this seems to be a copy/paste error from XnAP where the IE is optional), plus additional editorials for clarity.
§8.3.2.2: “which refers to” was reworded to the typical “as specified in”, and “release cause” replaced by IE name and value.
§8.3.12.4: Missing Abnormal Conditions section added.
§8.3.13.2: The 5GC Action IE is mandatory
§8.3.13.4: Missing Abnormal Conditions section added.
§8.4.1.2: Capitalization of IE name corrected (4 instances)
§8.4.9.1, 8.4.10.1, 9.2.3.16, 9.2.3.17, 9.3.1.108, 9.3.1.190: “NG-handover” changed to “NG-based handover” for consistency with legacy text.
§8.9.2.2: words that do not belong to message names should not be italicized.
§8.11.2.1: editorial correction from CB # 3_MultipleTrace.
§8.12.1.3, 9.3.1.65: “area of interest” should not be capitalized.
§9.2.2.7: Extra space deleted from “TS 23. 316”
§9.2.2.12: Extra period deleted from “TS. 38.300”
§9.2.6.7: IE type corrected
§9.2.17.8: IE reference corrected
§9.3.1.2: Cause value for “MBS Session Area Information” (which does not exist) changed to “MBS Service Area Information” plus other editorial cleanup.
§9.3.1.2: As decided during discussion of R3-237192 at RAN3#122, “rapporteurs to rephrase the ‘unspecified’ cause value description as: Sent when none of the specified cause values applies but still the cause is {x} related”.
 §9.3.1.25: IE names italicized
§9.3.1.29: missing criticality added, in alignment with ASN.1
§9.3.1.43/44: constants italicized
§9.3.1.65: missing range bound added, in alignment with ASN.1

§9.3.1.140: Presence value corrected, in alignment with ASN.1
§9.3.1.169: The SNPN TAI List IE and MDT SNPN List IE are renamed to align with the ASN.1, missing presence added, plus some editorial corrections in the criticality columns.
§9.3.1.169: Semantics description of the PNI-NPN Area Scope of MDT IE is reformulated since “PLMN Wide” is not an IE (it is a choice tag).
§9.3.1.190: An empty line is inserted between the IE table and the range definition table.
§9.3.1.233: “multi-path” changed to “multipath”.
§9.3.1.246: “information element” changed to “IE”.
§9.3.1.256: “Item” level removed, in alignment with ASN.1
§9.3.1.267: extra comma and double space deleted.
§9.3.2.2, 9.3.2.16: user plane changed to UP.
§9.3.2.6, 9.3.3.23: Missing presence added
§9.3.2.9: Presence value corrected, in alignment with ASN.1
§9.3.3.34, §9.3.3.35, §9.3.3.36: corrections to Criticality column.
§9.3.3.37: Presence value corrected, in alignment with ASN.1
§9.3.3.64: editorial correction from CB # 16_R18Redcap.
Miscellaneous minor editorials

sourceAuthoredSummary:
In clause 8.3.4.2, the text description for MP split SRB without duplication case is added, i.e. “If the Path Addition Information IE and the SRB Mapping Info IE are both contained in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message, the gNB-DU shall, if supported, setup one RLC entity if necessary for the direct path and map the indicated SRB to the Uu Relay RLC channel based on the SRB Mapping Info IE.”.
In clause 8.3.5.2, add multi-path relay based duplication.
In clause 8.3.4.2, 8.3.5.2, 8.4.2.2, if SRB duplication is activated, and the Execute Duplication IE is indicated, the gNB-DU can perform CA based duplication or multi-path relay based duplication for the SRB.
In clause 8.3.1.2, for Uu RLC channel to be setup list, suggest to remove “or a L2 MP Relay UE using N3C”.  And, in clause 9.2.2.1 and 9.2.2.2, for maxnoofUuRLCChannels, remove “or L2 N3C relaying”.
In clause 8.3.4.2, remove “or the logical channel”.

Impact analysis
Impacted functionality: 
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because the corrections are for NR SL multi-path relay. 
This CR has an impact under functional point of view.
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects NR SL multi-path relay.

source_summary_evidence.original_member: R3-240967 was R3-240658 PDU Session Not Admitted_Rel-17 XnAP CR_v2.docx

value_cells:
In 9.1.2.6, introduce a new optional sub-IE refer to PDU Session Resources Not Admitted List IE and mark the existing one as to be ignored if received. 

In 9.3.4, update asn.1 accordingly.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact under protocol & functional point of view. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the indication of not admitted PDU Sessions during S-NG-RAN node modification.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
1. To remove the “RRC multicast MTCH neighbour cell information” IE and/or the “threshold index” IE from “9.3.1.310 Multicast CU to DU RRC Information”.
2. To modify the upper bound of the “threshold index” IE from “maxnoofThresholdMBS” toward “maxnoofThresholdMBS-1”.
3. To define the “Multicast Common CU2DU Cell Information” in Section 9.3.1.314 as a SEQUENCE type and to remove the “No CU2DU Cell info provided” branch, as it could be realized by removing both MBS Multicast Neighbour Cell List  and ThresholdMBS-List IE. (ASN.1 section is kept unchanged.)
4. To add Transaction ID IE in the MULTICAST COMMON CONFIGURATION REQUEST/RESPONSE/REFUSE messages.(Merged from R3-240262)

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the Multicast reception in RRC_INACTIVE state function.
This CR is not backward compatible.

1.	Adding new IEs “F1-U TNL Info to Add or Modify List” and “F1-U TNL Info to Remove List” into the “BC MRB To Modify Item” structure for managing multiple F1-U TNL contexts, as well as adding a new IE “F1-U TNL Info Added or Modified List” into the response structure.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, will impact the OAM based IAB IP address allocation procedure.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
ASN.1: Within the MDT Configuration-NR IE, the Area Scope of MDT IE was extended by CR0990 with 4 additional choices.  All the new choices are encoded as a SEQUENCE (like the legacy choices) except PNI-NPN Based MDT which is encoded directly as a list. Therefore, the ASN.1 for PNI-NPN Based MDT is modified so that it is encoded as an extensible SEQUENCE like the other choice options.
ASN.1: Similarly, the ASN.1 for the PNI-NPN Area Scope of MDT IE is modified so that it is encoded as an extensible SEQUENCE.
9.3.3.65: The PNI NPN Area Scope of MDT IE is renamed to CAG List for MDT to reflect its actual content and make it more suitable for reuse.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Clarification of procedural text.
ASN.1: Within the MDT Configuration-NR IE, the Area Scope of MDT-NR IE was extended by CR1050 with 4 additional choices.  But while legacy choices are encoded as a SEQUENCE, some of the new choices are encoded directly as a list. Therefore, the ASN.1 is modified so that all choices are encoded as an extensible SEQUENCE like the legacy choice options.
ASN.1: Similarly, the ASN.1 for the PNI-NPN Area Scope of MDT IE is modified so that it is encoded as an extensible SEQUENCE.
9.2.3.191: The PNI NPN Area Scope of MDT IE is renamed to CAG List for MDT to reflect its actual content and make it more suitable for reuse.
9.2.3.126: The SNPN TAI List IE and MDT SNPN List IE are renamed to align with the ASN.1. SNPN-ID Based MDT is renamed to SNPN Based MDT (for alignment with NGAP).

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Section 8.19.4.3, 
Clarify the inter-gNB path switching can be based on Xn-HO, and NG-HO.  
Delete the “may” regarding HANDOVER REQUEST message “may” include the candidate U2N Relay UE.   
Correct the figure to use F1AP message name, rather procedure name.
Other small clarifications.

Section 8.22, corrections to align with the figure/description in TS 38.300
add a step at the end to describe when the MP is setup. 

In step 3 of Figures 8.22.1-1 and 8.22.3-1, the information contained in the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message for direct path addition includes at least the HandoverPreparationInformation IE and the serving cell ID on the direct path.
In Figure 8.22.1-1, step 5 should not related with the gNB-DU1, i.e., put the line related to gNB-DU1 above step 5.
In Figure 8.22.1-1, add an optional UE context modification procedure between gNB-CU and gNB-DU2 to update the configuration on the indirect path, as shown in the newly added step 5a and 5b. correspondingly, add the description for step 5a and 5b as follows.
5a. The gNB-CU may send an UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the gNB-DU2 to query the latest configuration if the configuration of the MP Remote UE on the indirect path is updated.
5b.	The gNB-DU2 responds with an UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message that includes the configuration information.”
In step 1 of Figures 8.22.2-1 and 8.22.4-1, change the signaling description to “candidate relay UE reporting” in the figure.
The MP remote UE can trigger the MP Relay UE via N3C by implementation if the MP Relay UE is in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE state.”
In step 3 of Figure 8.22.2-1, the reconfiguration to MP Relay UE is not related with gNB-DU1, thus move the step 3 under the line related to gNB-DU1.
In Figure 8.22.2-1, add an optional UE context modification procedure between gNB-CU and gNB-DU1 before step 6 to update the configuration on the direct path. correspondingly, the following text procedures are added.
“6a.	The gNB-CU may send an UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the gNB-DU1 to query the latest configuration if the configuration of the MP Remote UE on the direct path is updated.
6b.	The gNB-DU1 responds with an UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message that includes the configuration information.”
Fix the editorials

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Include MRB ID IE and BC Bearer Context F1-U TNL Info at DU IE in BROADCAST TRANSPORT RESOURCE REQUEST message.
Remove the F1-U tunnel Not Established IE in the BROADCAST CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message.
Introduce F1-U tunnel Not Established IE in the BC Bearer Context F1-U TNL Info IE, in the location independent branch for the MBS session, and also in the location dependent branch in per Area Session granularity.

Impact analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR may have an impact from functional point of view due to the movement of F1-U Tunnel Not Established IE from session level to MRB level. The changes can be considered isolated.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
A section on IAB-node authorization is added to TS 38.401. This section describes the RAN's behavior when receiving the IAB-node authorization indicator for the IAB-node.

The general behavior of the IAB-donor-CU receiving the IAB-node’s authorization status is the following:
In case the authorization status is “not authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU does not configure BAP address, BAP configuration or IP address, or, in case these parameters are already configured, it removes the configuration of these parameters.
In case the authorization status is “authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU follows phase 2 and phase 3 of the respective network integration procedure.

In case the IAB-node is dual-connected to an eNB and an IAB-donor operating in ENDC. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SeNB Addition/Modification Request message.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, will only impact the RAN handling for the authorization status for an Rel-17 IAB-node from CN.

A section on IAB-node authorization is added to TS 38.401. This section describes the RAN's behavior when receiving the IAB-node authorization indicator for the IAB-node.

The general behavior of the IAB-donor-CU receiving the IAB-node’s authorization status is the following:
In case the authorization status is “not authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU does not configure BAP address, BAP configuration or IP address, or, in case these parameters are already configured, it removes the configuration of these parameters.
In case the authorization status is “authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU follows phase 2 and phase 3 of the respective network integration procedure.

In case the IAB-node is dual-connected to an eNB and an IAB-donor operating in ENDC. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SeNB Addition/Modification Request message.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, will only impact the RAN handling for the authorization status for an Rel-17 IAB-node from CN.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
A section on IAB-node authorization is added to TS 38.401. This section describes the RAN's behavior when receiving the IAB-node authorization indicator for the IAB-node.

The general behavior of the IAB-donor-CU receiving the IAB-node’s authorization status is the following:
In case the authorization status is “not authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU does not configure BAP address, BAP configuration or IP address, or, in case these parameters are already configured, it removes the configuration of these parameters.
In case the authorization status is “authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU follows phase 2 and phase 3 of the respective network integration procedure.

In many IAB scenarios, the RAN node receiving the IAB-node’s authorization status from the AMF/MME is not the IAB-donor. In these cases, the authorization status is passed via Xn/X2 to the IAB-donor. This applies to the following scenario:
(1): The IAB-node is dual-connected to an eNB and an IAB-donor operating in ENDC. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SeNB Addition/Modification Request message.
(2): The IAB-node is dual-connected to a non-IAB-capable gNB and an IAB-donor, and the non-IAB-capable gNB is the MN. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SN Addition/Modification Request message.
(3) The IAB-MT is connected with a non-F1-terminating IAB-donor and the IAB-DU has F1 connection with an F1-terminating IAB-donor. In this case, the authorization status is sent from the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor to the F1-terminating IAB-donor via the Transport Management Modification Request message.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, will only impact the RAN handling for the authorization status for an Rel-17 IAB-node from CN.

In case the authorization status is “not authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU does not configure BAP address, BAP configuration or IP address, or, in case these parameters are already configured, it removes the configuration of these parameters.
In case the authorization status is “authorized”, the IAB-donor-CU follows phase 2 and phase 3 of the respective network integration procedure.

In many IAB scenarios, the RAN node receiving the IAB-node’s authorization status from the AMF/MME is not the IAB-donor. In these cases, the authorization status is passed via Xn/X2 to the IAB-donor. This applies to the following scenario:
(1): The IAB-node is dual-connected to an eNB and an IAB-donor operating in ENDC. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SeNB Addition/Modification Request message.
(2): The IAB-node is dual-connected to a non-IAB-capable gNB and an IAB-donor, and the non-IAB-capable gNB is the MN. In this case, the authorization status is passed via the SN Addition/Modification Request message.
(3) The IAB-MT is connected with a non-F1-terminating IAB-donor and the IAB-DU has F1 connection with an F1-terminating IAB-donor. In this case, the authorization status is sent from the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor to the F1-terminating IAB-donor via the Transport Management Modification Request message.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, will only impact the RAN handling for the authorization status for an Rel-17 IAB-node from CN.

sourceAuthoredSummary:
Add descriptions of the mobile IAB-node RLF recovery procedure to support the scenario where the new CU for the RLF recovery is different from the F1 terminating CU.
Capture the behaviour of the MT’s target IAB-donor when the mIAB authorization status = “non-authorized” is received during MT migration and RLF recovery.
Clarify that in presence of two logical DUs, DL traffic can be routed to the appropriate logical DU destination based on implementation, e.g., through TNL information.
Add a NOTE to the mobile IAB-MT migration that in absence of Xn interface between the target RRC terminating CU and F1 terminating CU, the passing of the content of Xn-based signalling is up to implementation.
Add PCI collision avoidance for mobile IAB in section 7.8.
Add Note to mobile IAB authorization clause for clarify the procedure to ensure the TMM procedure should be initiated by F1-terminating donor after F1 setup or MT migration.
Some editorial changes.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact on the functional point of view, which will impact the mobile IAB-node RLF recovery, mobile IAB-node integration, mobile IAB-MT migration, and mobile IAB-DU migration.

values.Title: Rel-18 Corrections of mIAB
values.Source: Ericsson, Huawei, Nokia, Nokia Shanghai Bell
values.Abstract:
Revision after the meeting:
CR1061 (R3-241181) vs CR1106 (R3-241171)
a.	There is a conflict in section 8.4.4.2.
b.	One observation is that CR1061 is a Cat-A CR, i.e. the changes in that CR are being made also in previous releases.
c.	Therefore, the overlapping changes in CR1106 should be removed (otherwise there is unnecessary mismatch with previous release).
d.	Proposed Conclusion: Revise CR1106 to remove the changes in 8.3.1.2, 8.3.4.2, 8.4.2.2, 8.4.4.2 (since they are already covered by the Cat-A CR1061).
